name: game-interface-design
description: Mobile-web game planning, player flows, HUDs, game feel, optional Figma UI, and FSD/ECS Three.js greybox prototypes.

interface.shortDescription: Plan games, then build FSD/ECS Three.js prototypes
interface.longDescription: Plan meaningful play, failure and replay, HUDs, game feel and business hypotheses; optionally produce editable Figma game UI; then turn the plan into a local Three.js prototype whose rules run in a headless ECS inside an FSD page slice, with typecheck, Steiger, headless, build and browser verification.
defaultPrompt: Design a one-handed mobile web game from its core decisions through player flows and a testable handoff.
Design a merge puzzle with meaningful placement choices, clear failure feedback, and rapid replay.
Build a playable Three.js greybox of the approved game plan with its rules in a headless ECS.
